programme.title: The Point With Liu Xin
programme.desc: The Point with LIU Xin is a current affairs program on CGTN. The program comments on global news through LIU Xin's very own unique perspective.

programme.title: O Segredo Do Refúgio
programme.desc: Dois casais alugam um refúgio perfeito à beira-mar, mas em pouco tempo o que deveria ser um fim de semana de descanso assume contornos sinistros…

programme.title: The Kitchen - Rainhas Do Crime
programme.desc: Bairro de Hell’s Kitchen, em 1978. Três donas de casa veem os maridos mafiosos presos pelo FBI. Com poucos recursos, decidem ocupar-se pessoalmente das questões da máfia irlandesa, revelando-se inesperadamente hábeis em tudo, da gestão de extorsões à eliminação dos concorrentes... literalmente.

programme.title: O Diário de uma Rapariga Adolescente
programme.desc: Minnie Goetze tem 15 anos, quer ser desenhadora de BD e está a crescer no ambiente frenético da São Francisco dos anos 70. É uma típica adolescente em quase tudo, exceto no facto de descobrir o sexo com o namorado da mãe, com quem acaba por manter uma relação, mesmo depois desta descobrir...

programme.title: Laranja Mecânica
programme.desc: No futuro próximo, Alex, o sádico líder de um gangue, é fascinado por roubo, violação e ultra-violência. Quando ele é preso, voluntaria-se para uma experiência de reabilitação por condicionamento psicológico, que não vai correr como planeado.

programme.title: Hollywood Ending
programme.desc: Val é um realizador de cinema prestigiado em fase descendente de carreira, que fica temporariamente cego na noite que antecede o primeiro dia de rodagem do seu novo filme, mas que tudo fará para que ninguém se aperceba dessa condição.

programme.title: Fúria De Viver
programme.desc: Jim Stark é o novo adolescente na cidade, cuja solidão, frustração e raiva refletem os sentimentos da juventude do pós-guerra. Agora, ele espera encontrar o amor com Judy e começa uma amizade com Plato e Ray, mas vai ser posto à prova entre corridas de carros e lutas com facas.

programme.title: Vicky Cristina Barcelona
programme.desc: Vicky e Cristina são duas amigas americanas a passar as férias de Verão em Barcelona, que se apaixonam pelo mesmo homem, o pintor Juan Antonio. Como se a situação já não fosse complicada, reentra em cena a ex-mulher dele, com quem ele sempre teve uma relação tempestuosa.

programme.title: Regra de Silêncio
programme.desc: A vida de Jim Grant sofre uma reviravolta quando um jovem jornalista expõe a sua verdadeira identidade de ex-membro de um grupo radical antiguerra procurado por assassinato. Depois de 30 anos com outra identidade, Grant é obrigado a fugir.

programme.title: Preto Ou Branco
programme.desc: Elliott Anderson, recentemente viúvo, fica responsável por cuidar da neta mas é levado a tribunal pela avó paterna, que quer obter a custódia da criança, obrigando as duas famílias a confrontarem-se com os medos e convicções mais profundos no que respeita a raça, perdão e compreensão.

programme.title: Yakuza
programme.desc: Harry Kilmer é um detetive norte-americano reformado que regressa ao Japão após décadas de ausência para tentar salvar a filha de um amigo, raptada pela organização criminosa nipónica cujos membros são conhecidos como Yakuza.

programme.title: À Deriva
programme.desc: Quando Tami e Richard, um casal de ávidos velejadores, se aventuram numa viagem pelo oceano, são atingidos por um furacão devastador. Após a tempestade, ela encontra-o gravemente ferido e o barco quase destruído, e vai ter de encontrar as forças necessárias para os salvar.

programme.title: Golpe Final
programme.desc: Quando um grupo de terroristas lhe raptam a sobrinha no estádio do West Ham durante um jogo de futebol, Michael Knox, um ex-soldado, trava uma guerra sem quartel para a salvar e prevenir uma bomba de explodir no recinto, que tem 35 mil pessoas lá dentro impedidas de sair.

programme.title: A Noite Interminável
programme.desc: Esta noite é como todas as outras para Mady, estudante de dia e serralheiro de noite. Mas Claire, a jovem enigmática que ele ajuda naquela noite, não é quem ela diz ser. Mady tem apenas uma noite para provar a sua inocência numa cidade belga em turbulência com a população em protesto.

programme.title: O Enigma da Rosa
programme.desc: Uma família vê a filha mais nova ser raptada a caminho da escola e recebe uma carta do raptor a pedir um encontro antes de libertá-la. Para surpresa de todos, em vez de dinheiro, o raptor quer a confissão do segredo de um dos membros da família.

programme.title: Sequestro Nas Montanhas
programme.desc: Um grupo de cinco montanhistas a fazer caminhadas e escaladas nas Terras Altas da Escócia descobre uma menina sérvia enterrada numa pequena câmara numa zona deserta, e vê-se apanhado num aterrorizante jogo de gato e rato com os sequestradores da jovem.

programme.title: Rapazes nas Árvores
programme.desc: Na noite de Halloween de 1997, Corey, Jango e o restante grupo de skaters despedem-se do liceu, mas o primeiro reencontra Jonah, seu amigo da escola primária, vítima de crueldade por parte do segundo, e o percurso de ambos de regresso a casa torna-se cada vez mais estranho e assustador.

programme.title: O Demónio De Raven's Hollow
programme.desc: Durante um exercício de treino a norte de Nova Iorque, Edgar Allan Poe, cadete da academia militar de West Point, e quatro outros cadetes, encontram um homem eviscerado. As suas últimas palavras remetem o grupo para uma comunidade esquecida, que eles acreditam estar a esconder terríveis segredos.

programme.title: Desafio ao Poder
programme.desc: Em 1936, na África do Sul, dez homens são presos por planearem atos de sabotagem e violência contra o governo sul-africano. O advogado Bram Fisher decide assumir a defesa dos detidos. Um dos homens é Nelson Mandela.

programme.title: Delatora
programme.desc: Kathy Bolkovac é uma agente do Nebraska que vai trabalhar para as Nações Unidas como pacificadora na Bósnia. Só que a sua vontade de ajudar é arrasada ao deparar-se com uma vasta rede de corrupção e tráfico sexual encoberta pela instituição.

programme.title: Parasitas
programme.desc: Uma família coreana no desemprego começa a ter um interesse peculiar por uma outra, com um estilo de vida cheio de glamour, até que todos se envolvem num acontecimento absolutamente inesperado.

programme.title: Um Dia De Chuva Em Nova Iorque
programme.desc: Gatsby e Ashleigh são um casal de estudantes de faculdade que passam um fim-de-semana a visitar Nova Iorque, onde ela tem a tarefa de entrevistar um realizador de cinema para o jornal da universidade e onde ambos vão viver várias aventuras que vão provocar um sério abalo na sua relação.

programme.title: In Memoriam
programme.desc: Harriet é uma reformada com a necessidade de controlar tudo o que se passa à sua volta, incluindo o que virá escrito no próprio obituário. Para isso, contrata uma jovem Anne, para lho escrever ainda em vida para que ela o possa aprovar, o que vai dar origem à mais improvável das amizades.

programme.title: Zona Proibida
programme.desc: John Wall é uma alma perdida que vagueia pela cidade de Nova Iorque e que acaba por ter uma ligação especial com duas jovens com quem passa o aniversário, refletindo sobre os percursos pelos quais as suas vida autodestrutivas os levaram.

programme.title: A Força Em Alerta
programme.desc: Quando um grupo de terroristas toma de assalto um couraçado da marinha americana, a única pessoa capaz de os deter é um ex-Navy Seal que é atualmente o cozinheiro da embarcação.

Quando uma arma ultrassecreta cai em mãos erradas, a agente da CIA Mason “Mace” Brown terá de unir forças com a sua rival Marie, com a antiga aliada do MI6 Khadijah e ainda com a hábil psicóloga colombiana Graciela, numa perigosa missão na qual terão de enfrentar a misteriosa Lin Mi Sheng.

programme.title: Um Ranger Especial
programme.desc: Alex Tyree é um Texas Ranger que persegue o assaltante de bancos Declan McBride através do deserto, quando descobre que ele é um terrorista internacional que tenciona detonar uma bomba no coração de Londres.

programme.title: Harry - O Detective Em Acção
programme.desc: Um a um, criminosos que conseguiram escapar à condenação em San Francisco estão a ser assassinados por polícias motorizados a agir fora da lei. E mesmo que o detetive Harry Callahan não morra de amores pelo sistema, ele não vai deixar os oficiais fazerem justiça pelas próprias mãos.

programme.title: O Último A Cair
programme.desc: Após uma pandemia ter dizimado o mundo, o antigo soldado John Wood vive isolado numa floresta até lhe aparecer a pedir ajuda uma mulher ferida que parece ter o segredo para acabar com o vírus.

programme.title: Laranja Mecânica
programme.desc: No futuro próximo, Alex, o sádico líder de um gangue, é fascinado por roubo, violação e ultra-violência. Quando ele é preso, voluntaria-se para uma experiência de reabilitação por condicionamento psicológico, que não vai correr como planeado.

programme.title: Gluck - Iphigénie en Tauride
programme.desc: Iphigénie en Tauride (1779) is a four-act tragic opera by German-born composer Christoph Willibald Gluck. Written for the French stage, the work’s premiere in 1779 at the Parisian Royal Academy of Music was a great success. Iphigénie en Tauride is one of the composer’s ‘reform operas’, meaning that the music was to follow the drama and its expression.

programme.title: Summer Night Music - Love Songs
programme.desc: In Summer Night Music - Love Songs, artists from all over the world contribute their favourite love songs to an unusual and exciting event uniting classical, jazz, and world music. Among the classical musicians are the Gewandhaus Orchestra, cellist Mischa Maisky, and The King’s Singers. Other world stars include jazz vocalist Dee Dee Bridgewater and flamenco cantaora Mayte Martin.

programme.title: Discovering Masterpieces - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: This episode presents the Brandenburg Concertos by Johann Sebastian Bach (1685-1750). Musical excerpts played by the Freiburger Barockorchester conducted by Gottfried von der Goltz. Bach's six Brandenburg Concertos rank among the undisputed favorites of all baroque fans. They have become a firm fixture in music education and an integral part of our international musical heritage. So what's their secret?

programme.title: Beethoven - Triple Concerto, Op. 56
programme.desc: American conductor Leonard Slatkin leads the Orchestre National de Lyon in a concert recorded at the Auditorium de Lyon in 2014. The concert opens with William Bolcom´s Circus Ouverture, which was specially composed for Slatkin's 70th birthday. The concert continues with a performance of Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C, Op. 56 performed by three female soloists: Olga Kern (piano), Baibe Skride (violin) and Sol Gabetta (cello).

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 40, K. 550
programme.desc: Gianluigi Gelmetti conducts the Radio-Sinfonieorchester Stuttgart in a performance of W. A. Mozart’s Symphony No. 40 in G Minor (K. 550), directed for television by Janos Darvas. The work was composed in 1788 and is sometimes referred to as the 'Great G minor symphony', with the Symphony No. 25 being the 'Little G minor symphony'. The two are the only of Mozart’s 41 symphonies that were written in a minor key.

programme.title: Ravel - Ma mère l'Oye
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos
programme.desc: During the years when Bach was in the service of the courts of Prince Leopold in Köthen, he had his own orchestra and was contracted to compose a great deal of instrumental music. This gave him an opportunity to try new techniques and to develop his own instrumental style. The six Brandenburg Concertos belongs to these masterpieces which he composed for a small ensemble .

programme.title: Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 5
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Violin Concerto No. 5 in A major, K. 219, also known as the ‘Turkish Concerto’. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist.

programme.title: Modena - The Belcanto School
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 23, KV 488
programme.desc: Regarded as one of the finest interpreters of Romantic repertoire, Francesco Attesti (*1975) gave his first recital at age 11 and by the time he was 23, had earned the highest honours in piano from Florence’s Conservatorio Luigi Cherubini. In this recording of his 2016 Deeply Mozart concert tour, Attesti performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s piano concertos KV 449 and KV 488 with the Italian OIDA Orchestra and conductor Paolo Belloli.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Naples, City of Keyboards - Gaetano Greco
programme.desc: Before Porpora, Scarlatti and Pergolesi ruled the Neapolitan music scene there was Gaetano Greco, one of the finest music teachers and composers of his day.

programme.title: Beethoven’s Hair
programme.desc: Beethoven's Hair traces the unlikely journey of a lock of hair cut from Ludwig van Beethoven's corpse, and unravels the mystery of the composer’s tortured life and death. The film begins in modern times, when some Beethoven enthusiasts purchase the hair at a Sotheby's auction. The story then investigates the lock's previous owners. Eventually, science reveals Beethoven's “medical secret”.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60. Count Franz von Oppersdorff adored Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2 and offered the composer a large sum to write a similar work. Beethoven obliged and completed his Symphony No. 4 in the autumn of 1806.

programme.title: Albéniz - Iberia Book 1 And 2
programme.desc: Star pianist Daniel Barenboim performs the first and second books of Isaac Albéniz’s piano suite Iberia. Composed between 1905 and 1908, Iberia is in four books of three pieces each. This masterpiece paints twelve musical portraits of Spanish regions, traditions, and atmospheres. This performance was recorded at the Teatro Colón in Buenos Aires, Argentina, on August 19, 2000.

programme.title: Brahms - Tragic Overture in D minor, Op. 81
programme.desc: Manfred Honeck conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Brahms' Tragic Ouverture, Op. 81 during the Easter Concert in Baden-Baden 2016.

programme.title: Divas and Diamonds
programme.desc: Musicians of the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, the DR Big Band, and the Danish National Vocal Ensemble join forces under the baton of Klaus To¨nshoff in this dazzling concert featuring great songs from black and white cinema.

programme.title: Sibelius - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: In 2013, the Finnish conductor Hannu Lintu was appointed principal conductor of the Finnish Radio Symphony Orchestra. Lintu studied piano and cello at the Sibelius Academy and the Turku conservatorium in Sweden’s southeast. He started conducting at the Sibelius Academy.

programme.title: Abbado conducts Mahler No. 4 and Rückert-Lieder
programme.desc: Mezzo soprano Magdalena Kožená does not only make the heavenly joys resound in the final movement of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 4, earlier in the concert, she devotes herself to the seraphic beauty and intimate simplicity of Mahler’s Rückert Lieder. Practically all songs that Mahler composed prior to 1900 were based on texts from Des Knaben Wunderhorn, a collection of folk poems published by Clemens Brentano and Achim von Arnim.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Fantasie in C, Op. 17 in 1836, revising it prior to publication in 1839.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw
programme.desc: Since his spectacular debut recital at the Amsterdam Concertgebouw in 2002, pianist Misha Fomin has become an indispensable part of Dutch musical life. National and international press praise his playing for its fluently natural virtuosity, rich color palette, and great musical intelligence.

programme.title: Smetana – Vltava (The Moldau) from Má vlast
programme.desc: Canadian conductor Yannick Nézet-Séguin leads the Berliner Philharmoniker in a wonderful performance of the symphonic poem Vltava (The Moldau) from Bedrich Smetana’s Má Vlast (My Country). This performance was part of the Waldbühne Concert 2016 in Berlin.

programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron.

programme.title: Johan de Meij - Symphony No. 1 “Lord of the Rings”
programme.desc: This concert is the result of the collaboration between the “Giuseppe Nicolini,” Conservatory of Piacenza, and the “Giuseppe Verdi,” Conservatory of Milan, as part of the project 'MIlanoPIACEnza ... suonare insieme”. On the program are works by the Dutch conductor and composer Johan de Meij. His Symphony No. 1 for woodwind and brass orchestra is titled “Lord of the Rings” and is based on the famous trilogy by writer J. R. R Tolkien.

programme.title: Bach Concerto And Mendelssohn Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: The legendary Sir András Schiff takes on the dual role of conductor and soloist in this special concert with the Freixenet Symphony Orchestra of the Reina Sofía School of Music. The program opens with Johann Sebastian Bach’s Keyboard Concerto No. 5 in F minor, BWV 1056, with Schiff himself at the piano. The concert concludes with Felix Mendelssohn’s magnificent ‘Italian’ Symphony No. 4.

programme.title: Ravel - Piano Concerto in G major
programme.desc: Mikhail Pletnev leads the Russian National Orchestra in a performance of Maurice Ravel's Piano Concerto in G major, featuring Lucas Debargue as the soloist. The composer completed this lively three-movement Piano Concerto in 1931. He incorporated several jazz elements in the work, especially in the two outer movements.

programme.title: Donizetti - Don Pasquale
programme.desc: Frédéric Chaslin leads the Orchestre Symphonique Région Centre-Val de Loire/Tours and the Choir of Opéra de Tours in a performance of Gaetano Donizetti’s comic opera Don Pasquale (1842). Featuring a cast of the most famous singers of the day, Don Pasquale premiered at the Parisian Salle Ventadour in 1843. It was an immediate success, being performed in the great opera houses of Europe within a year after its premiere.

programme.title: A Tango Night - Live from Buenos Aires
programme.desc: 2006 closed with a spectacular festival of Argentinean music broadcast live from Buenos Aires. At the height of the Argentinean summer, the Orquesta Filarmónica del Teatro Colon under Daniel Barenboim (conductor And soloist) join bandoneon virtuoso Leopoldo Federico and his Orquesta Tipica for an extraordinary New Year’s Eve show with popular tangos and Latin American orchestra classics.

programme.title: England, my England - I
programme.desc: From August 28 to September 6, 2015, the Early Music Festival Utrecht focused on England, my England. On the basis of the festival theme, presenter Lex Bohlmeijer takes the viewer in a two-part documentary on an intriguing journey through England of the Middle Ages, Renaissance and Baroque, and relates this to the city of Utrecht.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: Franz Liszt (1811 - 1886) composed 13 symphonic poems, largely inspired by literary texts. The composer himself wrote piano duet arrangements for these pieces, showcasing his incredible ability of imitating a full orchestra on the piano. Liszt, one of the 19th century’s most important piano virtuosos, strongly influenced the further development of piano music.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Baroque Christmas Concert
programme.desc: This splendid Christmas concert was recorded live from the Freiburg Cathedral in 1999. It features soprano Barbara Bonney, recognized worldwide for the clarity of her voice and the precision of her diction, and the baritone Matthias Goerne, one of the most promising singers of his generation.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Jeu de cartes
programme.desc: Iván Fischer conducts the Budapest Festival Orchestra in a concert recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary in 2015. The concert opens with Sergei Prokofiev's Overture on Hebrew Themes, Op. 34. After this, Thomas Zehetmair stars as solo violinist in Prokofiev Violin Concerto No. 2, Op. 63. The second part of the concert is features music by Igor Stravinsky.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 4, 5 And 12
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 1 BWV 1014
programme.desc: This Sonata for Violin and Harpsichord No. 1 BWV 1014 is the first of the set of sonatas Johann Sebastian Bach composed before 1725, probably during his time as chapel master in Köthen. Presumably, he wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig.

programme.title: Summertime at the Domaine Forget
programme.desc: The documentary Summertime at the Domaine Forget introduces internationally renowned treasure: Domaine Forget festival in Saint-Irénée, Québec. Domaine Forget is one of Canada's leading music academies and hosts this annual festival to promote music and dance.

programme.title: Bach - The Well-Tempered Clavier No. 24
programme.desc: In 1722, when Johann Sebastian Bach lived in Köthen, Germany, he published a book of preludes and fugues in all 24 major and minor keys. This collection became known as The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book One, BWV 846–869. About two decades later, Bach compiled a second book in Leipzig, which became known as The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book Two, BWV 870-893.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: The Lucerne Festival Orchestra performs Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 5 under the direction of Claudio Abbado. This unique orchestra was formed as part of the annual festival in Lucerne, Switzerland.

programme.title: Fomin plays Schumann, Beethoven and Tchaikovsky
programme.desc: After a successful inaugural recital in 2016, pianist Misha Fomin returns to the stage in the intimate hall of the Concertgebouw Amsterdam on November 11, 2017. Celebrated by the local and international press for his natural virtuosity, the rich texture of his play and his great musical intelligence, Fomin interprets Fantasia, op. 17 by Schumann, Piano Sonata No. 30, op.

programme.title: Documentary 2017
programme.desc: This short documentary follows the participants of the 11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held in TivoliVredenburg, Utrecht, in 2017. The competition actively presents, develops, and promotes piano talents from around the world. In doing so, it has become one of the prominent gateways to the international professional classical music scene for young musicians.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 3 BWV 1016
programme.desc: Johann Sebastian Bach’s Sonata for Violin and Harpsichord No. 3 BWV 1016 belongs to a group of sonatas composed before 1975, probably during the composer’s tenure as Kapellmeister at Köthen. He presumably wrote these sonata’s for Prince Leopold, later adapting them for his own purposes in Leipzig.

programme.title: Schubert - Overture to Rosamunde (D. 644)
programme.desc: Andreas Spering conducts Philharmonie Zuidnederland in a performance of 'Overture Rosamunde' (D. 644), by Franz Schubert (1797-1828). Recorded in Muziekgebouw Eindhoven, the Netherlands in 2015. Schubert initially composed the Overture for Georg Ernst von hofmann's play 'Die Zauberharfe' ('The Magic Harp'), which premiered on August 19, 1820.

programme.title: Vocal works by Handel, Conti, Purcell a. o.
programme.desc: Every year in late August, the renowned Early Music Festival takes place in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It is the world's largest festival focused on early music, attracting an audience of over 70 thousand visitors. Due to the corona pandemic, the 2020 edition of the festival took place in an alternative form, offering an alternative program that included live concerts as well as daily livestreams of concerts and archive recordings.

programme.title: Symphonies in D by Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig’s Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek’s Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek’s only symphony – was never performed during the composer’s lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Ukrainian conductor Kirill Karabits leads the London Symphony Orchestra in a stunning performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 4. The soloist is soprano Lucy Crowe. Mahler’s Fourth Symphony opens with the sound of sleighbells and melodies of childlike innocence. But between this deceptively playful opening and the serene finale – a child’s vision of Heaven – lies a world of profound emotion and beauty.

programme.title: Shostakovich - 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87
programme.desc: English-French pianist David Levy performs Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87. The work is a set of twenty-four pieces for piano, one in each of the major and minor keys of the chromatic scale. Each piece is in two parts: a prelude followed by a fugue. The composer was doubtlessly inspired by J. S.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Lensky’s aria from Eugene Onegin
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: The 12 Cellists - Documentary
programme.desc: Directed in 2012 by Enrique Sánchez Lansch, the documentary The 12 Cellists follows the 12 cellists of the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra. Since 1972, this group is a staple of the international musical universe. Whether they play classical music, jazz, tango or avant-garde music, these talented musicians invariably enthrall audiences with the wide range of unique and bewitching sounds they produce with their cellos.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. This symphony shows Beethoven’s loyalty to the model of Joseph Haydn’s and Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s late symphonies, yet reveals his attempt to distinguish himself from his predecessors.

programme.title: Balanchine
programme.desc: In this compilation of enchanting choreographies by George Balanchine, the New York City Ballet pays tribute to the man who founded the dance company in 1948 together with Lincoln Kirstein.

programme.title: Dvorák - Symphony No. 8, Op. 88
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker is one of the world’s finest orchestras, its fame stretching all the way to Japan. Unsurprisingly, this 2000 concert, recorded at Tokyo’s magnificent Suntory Hall, was a resounding success. Mariss Jansons conducts a beautiful program that includes Antonin Dvorák’s Symphony No. 8, Carl Maria von Weber’s Overture to Oberon, and Dmitri Shostakovich’s Violin Concerto featuring star violinist Hilary Hahn (*1979).

programme.title: Dupré - Variations on Two Themes, Op. 35
programme.desc: Italian pianist Alessandro Marangoni and Italian organist Paolo Oreni perform Marcel Dupré’s Variations on Two Themes for piano and organ, Op. 35. Designed by the organist himself, Oreni plays his ‘Wanderer’ organ in this performance, which is currently the largest existing transportable pipe organ. With its 1200 pipes and 42 stops, it has all the essential timbres needed for the organ repertoire.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Meyerbeer - Les Huguenots
programme.desc: The dramatic events surrounding the St. Bartholomew's Day massacre, in which approximately 3000 Protestants were murdered by Catholics, forms the setting for this historical ‘grand opera’ by Giacomo Meyerbeer. Protestant Raoul is in love with Catholic Valentine: an impossible love. Religion is not the only matter that keeps the two lovers apart, as Valentine has been promised to the Catholic Comte de Nevers, his enemy...

programme.title: Waldbühne 1995 - American Night
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra, which plays pieces by George Gershwin and Leonard Bernstein as part of a musical celebration of Americana. This concert was presented at the Waldbühne in Berlin, a green theatre based on the amphitheatre of the ancient Greek city of Epidaurus which is one of Berlin's favorite outdoor scenes because of its enchanting setting.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.desc: No ‘Língua Mãe’, Luís Represas sai em busca dos autores portugueses. Ele e a namorada vivem num quarto de uma pensão na capital espanhola, cuja proprietária é uma viúva. Paco vai envolver-se numa relação muito quente com a atrativa viúva e, passado algum tempo, os amantes são descobertos pela noiva. Obcecado com a sua amante Paco vai ter de decidir com quer viver.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 35
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 31
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 69
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 37
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Segure Minha Mão T1 - Ep. 27
programme.desc: A história gira em torno de uma garota chamada Azra, que está estudando no exterior, na América, para se tornar cozinheira profissional, assim como seu pai.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 33
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 71
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Teus Nobel live at the Bimhuis Amsterdam
programme.desc: Teus Nobel is a Dutch trumpet and flugelhorn player. As a little boy, he was inspired by ‘power’ trumpeters such as Maynard Ferguson and Bill Chase. While studying at the conservatory, he played both as jazz player and as a commercial session musician at musicals. After his time at the conservatory, he started playing in the Royal Netherlands Air Force Orchestra, playing march music influenced by pop and jazz.

programme.title: The Art Farmer Quartet live In England
programme.desc: Art Farmer: Live in '64?highlights an amazing one-hour concert featuring the great flugelhornist in his prime. Farmer’s band includes legendary guitarist Jim Hall (fresh from Sonny Rollins’ band), drummer Pete LaRoca, and Steve Swallow on bass. The legendary ensemble plays both standards and originals with ease and finesse and highlights why Farmer was considered one of the most innovative horn players in all of jazz.

programme.title: Paradox Live: BRUUT!
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Carla Bley Sextet live at Estival Lugano 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Discover the special bond between pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow.

programme.title: Peter Beets Trio And Goudsmit: Tribute to Montgomery
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: Needless to Say
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. Enjoy the musical wealth of the All Star Band in this episode of Morgenland Festival.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Count Basie and his Orchestra live in Charleroi
programme.desc: Count Basie is one of the most important bandleaders of the swing era. With the exception of a brief period in the early '50s, he led a big band from 1935 until his death almost 50 years later. Basie's orchestra was characterized by a light, swinging rhythm section that he led from the piano, lively ensemble work, and generous soloing. Basie was not a composer like Duke Ellington or an important soloist like Benny Goodman.

programme.title: Artvark Saxophone Quartet And Ntjam Rosie: Homelands
programme.desc: Homelands is a collaboration between Artvark Saxophone Quartet and Cameroonian-Dutch singer Ntjam Rosie. The music is inspired by both traditional and modern music from Ntjam’s home country Cameroon, (Manu Dibango and Richard Bona) as well as by an Afro-European blend of soul, jazz, gospel and world music.

programme.title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: A Tango Night - Live from Buenos Aires
programme.desc: 2006 closed with a spectacular festival of Argentinean music broadcast live from Buenos Aires. At the height of the Argentinean summer, the Orquesta Filarmónica del Teatro Colon under Daniel Barenboim (conductor And soloist) join bandoneon virtuoso Leopoldo Federico and his Orquesta Tipica for an extraordinary New Year’s Eve show with popular tangos and Latin American orchestra classics.

programme.title: Sly Johnson And Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday.

programme.title: Al Di Meola - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone.

programme.title: Con Alma
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Oscar Peterson - C Jam Blues
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson’s virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: We Are Birds - La Ciotat
programme.desc: Nordic afro jazz project 'We Are Birds' saw the light between Finland and Africa, during a 2010 jam session in which Finnish jazz pianist Tuomas A. Turunen met African drummer-percussionist and urban griot Dimitri Reverchon. The two composers set their mind to exploring this hybrid genre, and found their perfect complement in bassist Emmanuel Soulignac, who brought his pop influences to the table.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Blues
programme.desc: In 1971, the camera crew of the Western series Gunsmoke travelled from Hollywood to the Pacific Northwest to capture blues greats Muddy Waters, Big Joe Turner, Big Mama Thornton and George “Harmonica” Smith during their tour. This documentary shows some of their best performances at the University of Oregon followed by footage and interviews on the road.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: World-renowned American blues singer and guitarist Magic Slim performed an electrifying set at the French festival Jazz à Vienne 2012. With bandmates John McDonald (guitar And vocals), Andre Howard (bass), and Brian Jones (drums), the blues giant played a string of classic Chicago blues hits. Ever energetic, the veritable blues veteran put on a dynamic show for an enthusiastic audience in the atmospheric ancient Roman theatre of Vienne.

programme.title: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks and Co: Estival 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Cavaliere and Mohy Duo
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Dragon
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: The Jackson Singers
programme.desc: The American gospel group The Jackson Singers, founded by Bob Jackson in 1980, found a warm welcome in Europe, where they have toured for decades. Embraced for their powerful spirituals and gospel music, they have become a celebrated presence in churches, cathedrals, and jazz festivals across the continent.

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel meets Peter Beets Trio
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Tribute to Elis Regina - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: Julie Campiche Quartet at the Hafensommer Festival
programme.desc: The use of the harp in jazz is quite rare, especially in modern groups that also incorporate electronic effects. The combination of a harp with more conventional jazz instruments and electronic manipulation makes the Julie Campiche Quartet a unique ensemble in today’s jazz world.

programme.title: Tivoli Utrecht: Sven Hammond Soul
programme.desc: Although its music might sound like the sound track of any 1970s American car chase movie, the band Sven Hammond Soul is from the Netherlands. This steaming soul machine is headed by Sven Figee, who prefers to attack rather than play his Hammond organ. In April 2012, the band was augmented with vocalist Jenny Lane. Today’s recordings were made at a steaming live performance at Utrecht’s Tivoli in 2012.

programme.title: Reckless Smile: Sazz Leonore
programme.desc: With her relaxed, bright voice, vocalist Sazz Leonore has made her name on the Dutch jazz scene. Lorrèn grew up in a family of music fans: from a very early age, she developed a fondness for the music of her great jazz heroine, Billie Holiday and Ella Fitzgerald. In this ‘Reckless Smile’ concert, which was recorded at Amsterdam’s North Sea Jazz Club, the vocalist knows how to entertain the audience.

programme.title: The Crusaders: Estival Lugano 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: Duke Ellington Orchestra - Het Concertgebouw
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: November Music: R. Frerichs/H. Alizadeh/Cello8ctet
programme.desc: The November Music festival in ‘s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands is the ultimate event for experiencing a broad range of music. It features a wonderful variety of contemporary and experimental pop, sound art, non-Western music, jazz and free improvisation.

programme.title: Saluzzi, Mariano And Dauner live in Stuttgart
programme.desc: Dino Saluzzi, one of Argentina's tango music masters, has been building his legacy since the mid-1980s. His accordion-like bandoneon defines Argentina's tango music. Saluzzi has explored many paths—paths along which he has rarely travelled more than once, despite some common threads.

programme.title: Face au Public: Odetta
programme.desc: Legendary African-American folk singer Odetta (1930-2008) sang her spirituals with immeasurable sorrow and anguish. Her spiritual music expresses the horrific impact of slavery on millions of African people stolen from their homeland. For Odetta, folk music—be it spirituals, blues or field songs—was a vehicle for expressing the racism and injustice experienced by black people dating back to the days of slavery.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Buck Clayton - Radio Télévision Suisse 'Variétés'
programme.desc: In the second half of June 1965, during a prolonged European concert tour, American trumpeter Buck Clayton (1911–1991) played a residency at the Chikito, a club in Bern, Switzerland.

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians.

programme.title: Mezzoforte - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1986, famed Icelandic jazz fusion band Mezzoforte performed for over an hour at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Betty Carter/Jazzmeia Horn, Please Do Something
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar).

programme.title: Anita Oday Live in Sweden 1963
programme.desc: Anita O’Day?boasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the “jazz singer supreme” in impeccable form. O’Day’s horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites “Tea For Two” and “Sweet Georgia Brown” (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.

programme.title: On Piano
programme.desc: Jazz first gained a foothold on Latvian soil in the 1920s. A century onward, this documentary traces the first two decades of jazz in Latvia in this portrait of Jack Michalicky, the first known Latvian jazz pianist. Michalicky was a musician from head to toe – a gifted violinist, he truly felt at home at the piano. Slender and lithe, the imaginative pianist’s fingers flew across the keys like a true miracle.

programme.title: Gonzalo Rubalcaba Quartet - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1991, Cuban pianist Gonzalo Rubalcaba was one of the artists appearing here.

programme.title: Nubiyan Twist - Music Meeting
programme.desc: Since 1985, the Dutch city of Nijmegen has been welcoming the International Music Meeting Festival every Pentecost. Ranging from jazz and improvisational music to traditional music and unique crossovers, this adventurous festival is all about musical encounters and international collaborations. In 2019, the band Nubiyan Twist performs at the International Music Meeting Festival.

programme.title: Live at The Metro Theatre
programme.desc: Angus And Julia Stone are an Australian brother-sister folk-blues group which formed in 2006. Their parents played as a folk duo before Julia and Angus were born. Angus And Julia Stone have released two studio albums, A Book Like This (8 September 2007), which peaked at No. 6 on the ARIA Albums Chart; and Down. Here they perform at The Metro Theatre, in Sydney, Australia, on October 10, 2007.

programme.title: Hall And Oates - Live at Sydney Entertainment Centre
programme.desc: When Daryl Hall and John Oates took to the stage at Sydney’s Entertainment Centre as the iconic bass line of ‘Maneater’ began to play, the fans knew they were in for a treat. This duo may have been opening concerts with that irresistibly smooth number for years, but it never seems to lose its magic, and the crowd – an eclectic mix of teens and baby boomers alike – lapped it up.

programme.title: Moondog And The London Saxophonique
programme.desc: Moondog, a gaunt, mysterious and extravagantly-garbed blind street musician was celebrated among New Yorkers for two decades before gaining acclaim in Europe as an avant-garde composer conducting orchestras before royalty. Artists such as Charlie Parker, Leonard Bernstein, Steve Reich and Philip Glass have called him one of the great musical visionaries of our century.?Day in and day out, the man whose real name is Louis T.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz Archive: Wayne Shorter Quartet
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: SHYRE live at Festival Vue sur la Relève
programme.desc: SHYRE is the creative collaboration launched by Montreal-born vocalist and pianist Sarah Rossy. This five-member group mixes instrumental textures with ethereal ambience, taking the listener on a journey through passages of prose with unique aesthetics. SHYRE fuses pop-folk and jazz with symphonic timbres, and psychedelic ambience, employing lush strings, dynamic rhythms, and angelic harmonies.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Olivier Weindling
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: November Music: Jon Balke Siwan
programme.desc: Since 1993, the November Music Festival has been held every year at various locations in the Dutch city of 's-Hertogenbosch. Highlighting a variety of contemporary musical styles and contemporary composers, November Music is today one of the most important festivals dedicated to contemporary music in the Netherlands.

programme.title: Benny Goodman Septet - North Sea Jazz Part I
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: TorTube: Eric Vloeimans And Florian Weber
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans.

programme.title: Miriam Makeba Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Miriam Makeba, also named Mama Africa, was a South African singer, actress, United Nations goodwill ambassador, and civil-rights activist.

programme.title: Toninho - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this episode is Grammy-award nominated accordionist Toninho Ferragutti.

programme.title: MEGA Fights T1 - Ep. 46
programme.desc: MEGA Fights are premiere events from the sport of boxing including HBO World Championship Boxing and historic PPV events plus past, current and future World Champions. This episode features a WBC middleweight title bout between Sergio 'Maravilla' Martinez (45-2, 24 KOs) and Paul 'The Punisher' Williams (39-1, 27 KOs) from Boardwalk Hall in Atlantic City, New Jersey, USA, on November 20, 2010.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights T3 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: This episode features a lightweight title unification bout between Joel Casamayor and unbeaten Michael Katsidis, as well as kickboxing, sumo and more!.

programme.title: Judo for the World T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. In this episode we see the best of the first ever Judo Grand Prix from Cancun, stop to get to know number 2 ranked fighter in the world Tal Flicker, and show a demonstration on how to execute one of Flicker's favorite submissions. .

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 33
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Arturo Gatti facing off with Alfonso Gomez in what would be Gatti's final boxing match. Also on the card, Andre Berto takes on veteran Carlos Quintana on his way to stardom.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T30 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 2, from Ryogoku Kokugikan in Tokyo, Japan, features Terunofuji, Asanoyama, Takayasu and Wakatakakage.

programme.title: BWF Martial Arts T11 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: This episode features highlights from the Women's Forms as well as Boy's Weapons and Men's Traditional Forms.

programme.title: Prison Fighters T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: This series follows former Muay Thai champion Noy Khaopan and American Cody Moberly, two inmates in a Thailand prison, who after seven years are given the chance to fight for their release. By joining a controversial government modern day Prison Fight program, murderers and felons are given the chance to fight for their freedom, and possible redemption, through the ancient tradition of Muay Thai matches. Episode 4 of 4.

programme.title: World Karate Federation T2023 - Ep. 6

programme.title: Poderosas Do Cerrado - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Andréa passa um tempo de qualidade em família. Layla faz um shooting. As irmãs Lobo curtem um dia de folga. No último encontro as Poderosas fazem um balanço de tudo que viveram.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 50
programme.desc: Rafael pede Serena em casamento, Cristina se espanta com a notícia e apressa o plano para derrubar a rival. Roberval reforça o segredo do casamento com Dalila.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 152
programme.desc: Josefa fica cismada quando Gisleyne e Claudia encontram a aliança de Célio na mansão. Raul deixa Gerluce, Rogério e Zenilda intrigados quando diz que Edilberto estava junto de Samira nas negociações sobre o bebê. Herculano repreende Lena por manter contato com Joélly. Paulinho anuncia à família de Gerluce que Lena pode estar envolvida no esquema de tráfico de crianças.

programme.title: Império - Ep. 98
programme.desc: Comendador dá posição na diretoria da Império a Cristina, causando alvoroço entre seus filhos. Isis convida Maria Marta para reinauguração de restaurante. Zé Alfredo encontra Pajé.

programme.title: Orgulho E Paixão - Ep. 39
programme.desc: Motoqueiro Vermelho resgata Mariana do afogamento. Ema conta para Elisabeta que beijou Ernesto. Contrariando Darcy, Charlotte visita Uirapuru na prisão. Ema e Ernesto discutem. Charlotte dá um tapa no rosto de Uirapuru. Mariana desperta e Elisabeta conforta a irmã. Julieta decide levar Olegário para sua casa. Lorde Williamson liberta Uirapuru. Elisabeta questiona Ernesto sobre Ema.

programme.title: A Nobreza Do Amor - Ep. 29
programme.desc: Alika garante à família que só voltará para Barro Preto após falar com Nilo Peçanha. Eugênia passa mal ao ficar presa no elevador, e Lúcia/Alika a ajuda. Mirinho tenta beijar Lúcia/Alika e acaba sendo agredido por ela. Tonho acredita que Lúcia/Alika esteja envolvida com outro homem. Lúcia/Alika e sua família chegam para jantar com Eugênia e Eustáquio, e Virgínia e Marta se incomodam.

programme.title: A Próxima Vítima - Ep. 21
programme.desc: Nina sente ciúmes de Zé Bolacha. Marcelo manda Isabela não o procurar, enquanto for noiva. Irene diz a Carmela que Paulo Soares, Francesca e Hélio foram mortos pela mesma pessoa.

programme.desc: Bianca e Duca reatam o namoro. João quase tem sua primeira vez. Jade e Cobra se casam e se despedem de todos. Nat sofre vendo as fotos de Duca com Bianca.

programme.title: Orgulho E Paixão - Ep. 39
programme.desc: Motoqueiro Vermelho resgata Mariana do afogamento. Ema conta para Elisabeta que beijou Ernesto. Contrariando Darcy, Charlotte visita Uirapuru na prisão. Ema e Ernesto discutem. Elisabeta questiona Ernesto sobre Ema.

programme.title: Coração Acelerado - Ep. 128
programme.desc: Naiane finge estar junto a João Raul em sua festa, e o cantor se incomoda. Ronei se declara para Zilá e afirma que não quer perdê-la. Rosinha pede demissão para João Raul e passa a trabalhar com Agrado e Eduarda. Ronei decide que Eduarda viajará só com Leandro, a fim de poupar Agrado, que está com o pé machucado. João Raul convida Naiane para morar em sua mansão.

programme.title: Jornal Da Globo - Ep. 130
programme.desc: Traz um olhar mais analítico sobre os principais assuntos do dia. Conta com a colaboração de colunistas em áreas como economia e cultura.

programme.title: Rainha da Sucata - Ep. 135
programme.desc: Maria do Carmo fica balançada com a proposta de Armênia. Sérgio ofende Neiva e apanha de Saldanha. Armênia decide cortar os gastos na empresa. Laurinha recebe uma carta anônima.

programme.title: Império - Ep. 98
programme.desc: Comendador dá posição na diretoria da Império a Cristina, causando alvoroço entre seus filhos. Isis convida Maria Marta para reinauguração de restaurante. Zé Alfredo encontra Pajé.

programme.desc: Lúcia/Alika e sua família chegam para jantar com Eugênia e Eustáquio, e Virgínia e Marta se incomodam. Ladisa afirma a Akin que jamais esquecerá que foi Dumi quem atentou contra seu marido. Jendal insinua aos ingleses que precisa casar sua filha, e Mr. Campbell sugere que Mr. Jones corteje Kênia. Eustáquio elogia a visão de negócios de Lúcia/Alika. Niara percebe que Alika sentiu ciúmes de Tonho.

programme.title: A Próxima Vítima - Ep. 22
programme.desc: Marcelo diz a Ana que ela vai perder para Filomena. Juca diz a Helena que quer ajudar Ana a resolver seus problemas. Júlia enfrenta a polícia por causa dos meninos.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 51
programme.desc: Dalila consegue roubar o livro da contabilidade. Eduardo revela um segredo para Rafael e recebe conselhos do amigo. Guto leva flores para Serena. Felipe pede Mirella em casamento.

programme.title: Orgulho E Paixão - Ep. 40
programme.desc: Williamson dá dinheiro a Uirapuru para que o poeta deixe o Vale do Café. Com atraso, Lídia entrega a carta de Darcy a Elisabeta. Ema finge para Ernesto que não se sensibilizou com o beijo dos dois. Elisabeta agradece a carta de Darcy e anuncia que se mudará para São Paulo. Julieta toma a casa do Barão na justiça.

programme.title: Coração Acelerado - Ep. 129
programme.desc: João Raul explica seu plano a Naiane, que acredita que conquistará o rapaz novamente. Ana Castela e Gael curtem o momento juntos. Todos se envolvem com a eleição para a presidência do Grupo Amaral. Rosinha revela a Agrado que Naiane se mudou para a mansão de João Raul. Ronei se retira do pleito à presidência do Grupo Amaral para anunciar a candidatura de Zilá.

programme.title: Jantar O Quê?
programme.desc: Quando chega à noite, bate aquela vontade de desfrutar um momento gostoso, nesta hora, uma mesma dúvida nasce em muitos corações e estômagos diferentes: jantar o quê? Esta saborosa questão inspirou a criação do programa apresentado pela jornalista e chef de cozinha Larissa Januário. Em cada dia da semana, larissa vai ajudar os espectadores a fazer melhor escolha para o seu jantar.

programme.title: Tempo Técnico
programme.desc: Comandado por Elia Jr., o programa também terá na bancada os comentaristas Jorge Nicola e Sálvio Spínola (ex-árbitro e considerado um dos maiores analistas de arbitragem do Brasil). Análises táticas, debates e entrevistas com os principais técnicos do futebol Brasileiro.

programme.title: Depois Do Jogo

programme.title: Remos E Rumos

programme.title: Chefs Digitais
programme.desc: O canal Sabor And Arte traz para a TV toda a diversidade, repertório e frescor dos chefs de cozinha que conquistam cada vez mais espaço a internet. Das receitas simples às mais sofisticadas, os chefs digitais ensinam, divertem e nos surpreendem com criatividade e muito bom humor.

programme.title: Especial Arte1
programme.desc: Artistas de várias áreas das artes falam sobre suas carreiras e obras. Eles relembram como começaram na profissão, suas referências e parcerias, explicam escolhas e refletem sobre suas trajetórias.

programme.desc: A Civil Air Search and Rescue Association do Yukon enfrenta condições de voo traiçoeiras na investigação de um avião histórico desaparecido. programme.title: Yukon: Operação De Resgate T1 - Ep. 6

programme.title: Yukon: Operação De Resgate T1 - Ep. 7
